description:
Title: Farming Bot

Players want to create custom farming bots, that help them gather resources.
First you have to find out which resources you want.
Up to 10 resources in parallel can be collected, some resources are more urgently needed than others.
Some resources are required to create tools that are needed to gather other resources (create a custom logic of the dependencies in your game).
After all preferences are collected, your bot starts farming.
Sometimes,  random natural disasters strike and set your bot back.
Whenever some milestones are reached, you are notified.
During farming it is possible to update the list of to be farmed materials (at all times).
After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Brag"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Materials" name="Materials"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriorities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_UpdateRequested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChoosePostActions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostActionsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ProcessComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartFarming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_FarmingEvents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_MilestoneReached</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_DisasterStrikes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FarmingFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateBot" name="Begin creating a farming bot">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_SelectResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_SelectResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_SetPriorities</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource urgency priorities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_SetPriorities</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfigureDependencies" name="Configure tool and resource dependencies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Dependencies_StartFarming</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StartFarming" name="Start farming bot">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Dependencies_StartFarming</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartFarming_Farm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartFarming_Farm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_ResumeFarming</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Setback_ResumeFarming</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Update_ResumeFarming</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Farm_FarmingEvents</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">min(selectedResourceCount, 10)</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_FarmingEvents" name="Wait for farming event" gatewayDirection="Diverging" eventGatewayType="Exclusive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Farm_FarmingEvents</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Events_Milestone</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Events_Disaster</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Events_Update</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Events_Finished</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MilestoneReached" name="Farming milestone reached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Events_Milestone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Milestone_Notify</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Milestone">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingMilestoneReached</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Milestone_Notify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_ResumeFarming</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisasterStrikes" name="Random natural disaster strikes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Events_Disaster</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disaster_Setback</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Disaster">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">naturalDisasterOccurs</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Set farming bot back">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disaster_Setback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Setback_ResumeFarming</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_UpdateRequested" name="Farming list update requested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Events_Update</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Update_UpdateList</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Update">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingListUpdateRequested</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Update_UpdateList</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Update_ResumeFarming</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FarmingFinished" name="Farming bot finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Events_Finished</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Finished_ChooseActions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Finished">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingFinished</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChoosePostActions" name="Choose whether to brag and/or send materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Finished_ChooseActions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChooseActions_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" name="Select post-farming actions" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_Split_NoAction">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChooseActions_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Brag</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SendMaterials</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_NoAction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Brag">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Brag</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Brag_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_SendMaterials</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendMaterials_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" name="Complete selected post-farming actions" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendMaterials_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_NoAction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessComplete" name="Farming bot process complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SelectResources" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_SetPriorities" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dependencies_StartFarming" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies" targetRef="Task_StartFarming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartFarming_Farm" sourceRef="Task_StartFarming" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_FarmingEvents" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Events_Milestone" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents" targetRef="Event_MilestoneReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Events_Disaster" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents" targetRef="Event_DisasterStrikes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Events_Update" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents" targetRef="Event_UpdateRequested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Events_Finished" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmingEvents" targetRef="Event_FarmingFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Notify" sourceRef="Event_MilestoneReached" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_ResumeFarming" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_Setback" sourceRef="Event_DisasterStrikes" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Setback_ResumeFarming" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_UpdateList" sourceRef="Event_UpdateRequested" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_ResumeFarming" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Finished_ChooseActions" sourceRef="Event_FarmingFinished" targetRef="Task_ChoosePostActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseActions_Split" sourceRef="Task_ChoosePostActions" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">bragSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SendMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">sendMaterialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_NoAction" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Join" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendMaterials_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot process" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelectedFriends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
